acceptanceEvidence: src/domains/connections/index.ts (getRecordConnections, owner/admin only) and src/components/desk/record-connections.tsx are on the appliance, customer, agreement, purchase, seller, visit and invoice pages; tests/w17-connections-integration.test.ts checks the links for all seven kinds and that staff are refused.

The same component shows History from the activity log, newest first, with who, when and a plain-words action (plainAction never shows a raw code); the appliance page keeps its fuller timeline and now shows who; tests/w17-connections.test.ts and the integration test check the wording and the order.

src/domains/search/index.ts adds purchases (seller name, receipt number, seller) and sellers for owner/admin only; tests/w17-connections.test.ts proves staff never run those queries and the integration test proves serial-number search still works.

ApplianceStatus gains CLEANING (migration 20261017170000), a passed inspection goes there, listCleaningNeeded puts 'Clean (machine)' on Today linking to the appliance, and markCleaningDone (owner/admin, locked, audited, repeat-safe) makes it Available; proven in tests/w17-connections-integration.test.ts and tests/lifecycle.test.ts.

recordApplianceInspection calls ensureRepairDraftInTx on a fail: one undated repair visit, reused on a repeat, shown on Today as 'Schedule the repair'; proven by the second integration test (a second failed inspection leaves exactly one).

src/domains/portal/next-bill.ts sums the rent of each current rental with its next billing date, shown by NextBillCard on portal home and Billing with the tax-and-credits note in English and Spanish; tests/w20-portal.test.ts checks the total and the Spanish text.

src/domains/portal/pay-now.ts and the POST route /account/billing/invoice/[invoiceId]/pay open the invoice's own Stripe page only for the signed-in customer's overdue payable Stripe invoice; the Pay now button is on the invoice page and the billing list; tests/w20-portal.test.ts and the integration test prove someone else's, paid and local invoices get nothing.
OpenVisits on portal home shows Requested, Scheduled (date or 'Not scheduled yet') and Done for each open visit from getPortalHome; labels have Spanish text checked in tests/w20-portal.test.ts.

The problem-report confirmation, the ending-a-rental note on My rentals and the existing pickup confirmation say what happens next, in English and Spanish (portal-copy.ts; tests/w20-portal.test.ts checks the new Spanish entries).
src/domains/portal/line-display.ts shows a package line as 'Washer + Dryer Set (washer #A12, dryer #B07)' on portal home and My rentals; tests/w20-portal.test.ts checks the exact wording.

externalAcceptance: Real use after the daily release: the owner using Related and History, the Cleaning step and the repair draft on real machines, and a real customer seeing next bill and visit timelines. Pay now opening a real Stripe payment page needs the owner's real Stripe keys, which were not used. No live Stripe, customer email, SMS or spending was used.
Browser and accessibility checks of the changed pages run in exact-head CI.
evidence: Bundle W-17+W-20; planning commit da6bc7ed397c01ab8d1c645875fe8c7fbacd06e0 preserved.

Local: typecheck, lint and the plain-words check pass; 13 unit tests (plain history wording, owner/admin-only access, staff never searched for purchases or sellers, Cleaning rules, package set wording, next-bill total, Pay now rules and the pay route, Spanish copy) and 5 real-Postgres tests (cleaning flow, one repair draft however often it fails, Related and History on all seven kinds with staff refused, search roles, Pay now ownership) pass; the existing inspection, custody, Today and search suites were updated or still pass; exact-head CI pending.
